answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents vote, attest, or transact in lockstep, the ledger treats them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. A sybil farm stops being a safe haven, since each fake account adds cost but no extra income. Isolated clusters become an island whose combined weight is capped, so an attacker who spins up a hundred identities at dawn earns what one honest agent earns while paying a hundred registration puzzles.
